report:
Right thigh tumour, wide excision

Received in formalin is a wide excision specimen from the right thigh, measuring 160 x 110 x 80 mm. The specimen is oriented (long stitch proximal, short stitch superficial). Sectioning shows a fleshy, necrotic tumour measuring 110 x 70 x 60 mm, 2 mm from the closest (deep) margin. Representative sections are taken in 9 blocks.

(1-6) Tumour.
(7) Deep margin.
(8) Proximal margin.
(9) Distal margin.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Wide resection
- Tumour site: Trunk and extremities (right thigh)
- Tumour size: 110 x 70 x 60 mm (greatest dimension 110 mm)
- Tumour focality: Unifocal
- Tumour depth: Skeletal muscle, intramuscular

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show an undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma. The tumour is composed of pleomorphic spindle and polygonal cells arranged in sheets and short, haphazard fascicles. The tumour cells have enlarged, hyperchromatic nuclei with bizarre and multinucleated forms. The tumour cells are negative for MDM2, desmin, S100 and SOX10.
- Histologic grade (FNCLCC grading): Grade 3 (score 6 to 8, high grade)
  - Tumour differentiation: Undifferentiated (spindle cell and pleomorphic)
    sarcoma (score 3)
  - Mitotic rate: 32 mitoses per 10 HPF, 22 mm eyepiece (score 3)
  - Tumour necrosis: 30% (score 1)
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified

Margins
- Surgical margin: Uninvolved by tumour (closest 2.2 mm, deep margin)
  - Deep margin: Clear by 2.2 mm (block 7)
  - Proximal margin: Clear by 25 mm (block 8)
  - Distal margin: Clear by >20 mm (block 9)
  - Intact fascial envelope / fibrous pseudocapsule at the closest margin:
    Present

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT3

Additional findings
- Preresection treatment: No known preresection therapy
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy

Ancillary studies
- MDM2 amplification (FISH): No amplification detected

SOFT TISSUE, right thigh tumour, wide excision:
- UNDIFFERENTIATED PLEOMORPHIC SARCOMA,
- FNCLCC Grade 3,
- Resection margins clear.
